plan.title: Reject eRFX publish without project title

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the requested cylinder line item with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the missing title is the only publish prerequisite being tested.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Add one available QA vendor so publication is blocked specifically by the missing title.
Press Publish and assert that Procol refuses publication with the required title validation message.
